BINARY_TREE.correction: Fractional placement bounds are rounded up instead of truncated.

extended_length_paths_are_trusted.defect: A healthy install reported dependency_conflict when the extension path was long enough that Blender reported PIL._imaging.__file__ in Windows extended-length form (\\?\C:\...), because the trust check compared it against a plain-form extension root.
extended_length_paths_are_trusted.correction: dependencies._inside strips extended-length syntax from both operands before comparing.

lock_file_readable_beyond_max_path.defect: A healthy install reported wheel_missing when the extension path exceeded MAX_PATH, because _load_lock read dependencies.lock.json without extended-length syntax. Blender's embedded Python is not long-path aware, so the read failed and the lock appeared absent.
lock_file_readable_beyond_max_path.correction: _load_lock reads the lock through _filesystem_path, as _wheel_integrity already did.
lock_file_readable_beyond_max_path.regression_evidence: tests/blender/verify_atlas_workflows.py run with a work directory whose extension path exceeds 260 characters; not reproducible under a standalone long-path-aware python.exe.
